In the anime the men appear throughout the story and talk amongst themselves telling tall tales and exaggerated stories about their younger days. * Before the July 8, 2010 update, this area was called "Lion's Arch". * Before completion of the Battle for Lion's Arch quest, all the NPCs usually found in the [[Lion's Arch|town]] are visible from this area. {{Explorable areas in the War in Kryta}} [[Category:War in Kryta locations]] [[de:Burgfried von Löwenstein]]
